    ABOUT ME

    Defensive security, learned by doing — packets, logs and detections.

    I’m Baluprasath. I grew up around computers, but not for studying — I used them to play games for hours.

    In 12th standard, hacking movies inspired me. I watched YouTube tutorials and tried to learn how hacking works. My interest was at its peak, and I was a script kiddie in those days.

    Because of some situations, I took the Physics group in college and spent three years on that degree. But my interest in cyber security never went away. So when it was my turn, I joined the MSc in Cyber Forensics & Information Security at the University of Madras. I am still learning.

    While studying, I also had to start working. I joined TVS Group as a Security Associate. The work is simple, and it is not as deep in cyber security as I expected. I started with an interest in offensive security, but now I have come to defend, and I am building my skills toward a SOC Analyst role.
